ca-c.label: Centuries scored for CSK
ca-c.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
ca-c.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, COUNT(*) n FROM fact_batting_innings f JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = f.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id WHERE i.batting_team_id IN (9) AND f.runs >= 100 GROUP BY year

ca-w.label: Four-wicket hauls for CSK
ca-w.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
ca-w.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, COUNT(*) n FROM fact_bowling_spells f JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = f.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id WHERE i.bowling_team_id IN (9) AND i.innings_number <= 2 AND f.wickets >= 4 GROUP BY year

ca-cl.label: Close finishes in Chennai Super Kings' matches
ca-cl.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
ca-cl.filters: Close definition as in this series
ca-cl.query: WITH ms AS (SELECT m.match_id, CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, replace(m.date, '/', '-') dt, m.venue_id, v.city, m.team1_id t1, m.team2_id t2, m.winner_id w FROM matches m LEFT JOIN venues v ON v.venue_id = m.venue_id), inn AS (SELECT i.match_id, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 1 THEN i.batting_team_id END) bat1, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 1 THEN i.runs END) r1, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 2 THEN i.runs END) r2, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 2 THEN i.total_legal_balls END) b2, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) so FROM innings i GROUP BY i.match_id), dl AS (SELECT d.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.batter_runs = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sixes, SUM(d.total_runs) runs FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY d.match_id) SELECT ms.*, CAST(strftime('%w', ms.dt) AS INTEGER) wd, inn.bat1, inn.r1, inn.r2, inn.b2, inn.so, COALESCE(dl.sixes, 0) sixes, COALESCE(dl.runs, 0) runs FROM ms JOIN inn ON inn.match_id = ms.match_id LEFT JOIN dl ON dl.match_id = ms.match_id ORDER BY ms.dt
